project: Three-track RTX 5090 / dual RTX 3090 workstation price monitor

individual_module_lead.status: price anomaly only; do not recommend without four-unit identity confirmation

rules: prefer a factory-matched 4x32GB ECC RDIMM kit
do not include 256GB RAM in current Track A totals
buy separate modules only in one order with identical SKU revision rank speed timings voltage and preferably batch
motherboard QVL or memory-vendor TRX50 validation preferred
run full four-channel memory training and stability testing
never mix brands SKUs revisions capacities or memory types

products.layout: 4x140 front intake; 2x140 rear exhaust; 6x120 side GPU intake; AW420 3x140 top exhaust

products.alternative_rule: report price premium and value; never substitute automatically

products.primary: GIGABYTE X870E AORUS MASTER X3D ICE
products.dual_gpu_rule: Ryzen 9000 CPU-fed GPU slots operate PCIe 5.0 x8/x8 when both are used; not x16/x16
products.storage_lane_rule: M.2 does not reduce the CPU GPU pair; use M2A_CPU for the 9100 PRO and M2C_SB for the 990 PRO; avoid M2B_CPU when full USB4 bandwidth matters and avoid M2D_SB when the chipset PCIEX4 slot is needed
products.bios_rule: 9950X3D2 requires BIOS F8 or newer; prefer the latest stable BIOS

products.target_speed: DDR5-5600 or validated stable DDR5-6000 EXPO
rules: stability is more important than memory overclocking
verify the exact 2x64GB kit against GIGABYTE QVL or memory-vendor compatibility
official 9950X3D and 9950X3D2 memory support is DDR5-5600 with two DIMMs and DDR5-3600 with four DIMMs

products.pricing_source: same exact FE or ASUS ProArt offers as Track A
products.compromise: the motherboard operates two GPUs at PCIe 5.0 x8/x8, but the selected HAVN VGPU chassis is one-GPU-oriented and requires removal of the VGPU bracket for any two-GPU horizontal experiment

products.dual_gpu_warning: stock VGPU layout supports one vertical GPU; future two-GPU use requires removing the VGPU assembly and mounting both cards horizontally, with two ProArt cards especially airflow-constrained

products.fit_rule: 55mm radiator-plus-fan stack fits below the HAVN top 65mm no-RAM-overlap limit; dry-fit the large 118x92x92mm pump/display against motherboard VRM heatsinks

products.case_note: electrically sized for two GPUs, but the selected HAVN VGPU case is not chassis-ready for two GPUs in its stock layout

products.target: premium 1200W-1600W PSU appropriate for one RTX 5090
products.revision_caveat: current Morele offer is labelled ATX 3.0; continue searching for an unambiguous ATX 3.1/12V-2x6 value option

products.sharing_rules: M2B_CPU shares bandwidth with ASMedia USB4; M2D_SB disables chipset PCIEX4; M2E_SB is PCIe 4.0 x2; none of the documented M.2 slots reduces the CPU GPU x8/x8 pair

products.layout: 3x140 bottom intake; 3x140 right-side intake; 2x140 rear exhaust; PANORAMA 3x120 top exhaust

C_threadripper_dual_3090.name: Threadripper dual-used-RTX-3090 value workstation
C_threadripper_dual_3090.purpose: Lower-cost 48GB aggregate-VRAM local-AI alternative using the complete Track A Threadripper platform with two matching used RTX 3090 24GB cards instead of RTX 5090

products.required: two matching NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3090 24GB cards
products.primary_slim_target: EVGA GeForce RTX 3090 XC3 Ultra Gaming

slim_alternatives.geometry: dual-slot blower; exact dimensions must be verified

slim_alternatives.rule: only with a complete designed and leak-tested custom loop; price pump radiators fittings coolant and maintenance separately

products.market_fallback: matching Zotac RTX 3090 Trinity pair or another matching air-cooled pair only after exact geometry airflow and sustained-temperature validation
products.pricing_rule: Prefer a currently offered matching pair. Otherwise total two individual cards only when exact model SKU revision and simultaneous quantity-two availability are confirmed. Never form a recommended pair from unrelated marketplace listings.
products.memory_note: 48GB aggregate physical VRAM across two 24GB devices; never describe it as one transparent unified 48GB GPU

products.base_total: excluded until exact bridge generation slot spacing availability and delivered price are verified
rules: select GPU models and motherboard slots before bridge
bridge must match RTX 3090 generation and physical slot spacing
NVLink can improve NCCL/tensor-parallel communication but does not automatically pool VRAM
benchmark PCIe-only operation before treating NVLink as required

products.rule: Track C shares observed non-GPU component prices with Track A but must maintain a separate total and GPU price history

products.psu_rule: PRIME PX-2200 is sufficient; verify four independent 8-pin GPU leads and never daisy-chain high-power card connectors
products.cooling_rule: Prefer slim blower or approximately 2.2-slot cards; for open-air cards require a meaningful gap direct side intake mechanical support and sustained CUDA hotspot/memory-junction testing; undervolting is preferred

purchase_gates: seller identity and right to sell verified
invoice or written proof of ownership and serial numbers
prefer business seller with at least 12-month warranty; private sale requires in-person testing
matching exact model SKU revision cooler thickness and power connectors
30-minute sustained CUDA or OCCT load plus VRAM test
GPU core hotspot and GDDR6X memory-junction temperatures recorded
no artifacting throttling fan faults damaged connectors corrosion or undisclosed liquid/mining history
motherboard slot spacing lane allocation and optional NVLink bridge spacing verified

allowed_discovery_channels: established Polish/EU refurbishers and workstation resellers
track_c_used_market_exception.rule: Track C explicitly requires used or professionally refurbished RTX 3090 cards, so used marketplace offers may be recorded as leads despite the default exclusion policy. They are not qualifying BUY NOW offers until seller identity, ownership, serials, matching pair, test evidence, condition, warranty/returns and safe transaction method are validated.
preference_order: business seller with invoice and at least 12-month warranty
established refurbisher with written test report and returns
private local seller with in-person testing and proof of ownership
remote private marketplace offer only as a provisional price reference
prohibited: advance bank transfer to unverified private seller
forming a pair from unrelated listings
cards with unresolved artifacts, damaged connectors, corrosion, liquid damage or failed VRAM/thermal tests
